Registers state predicates KBM, Visible with exact ordered tests below. Connects 2 model/path references; the model subscription effects below specify which receiver changes and under which nil/value guard. Installs 1 event/action/override bindings; the KBM predicate28-30 captures controller f1_arg1 only, while Visible34-36 uses global AlwaysTrue only; both ignore their menu/element/event formals. The input_source_changed callback39-42 captures menu f1_arg0 and self, uses delivered event f4_arg1 and ignores f4_arg0. The LastInput callback46-54 captures menu/self/controller and requests get() on its delivered model f5_arg0. Registration is separate from invocation; provider, delivery and receiver failures remain unresolved. The ordered effect contract retains every property, model, visual, navigation, callback and return mutation in source order; returning self is not proof the original game loads this widget.
